Construction Simulator: Evolution is coming to PS5 – Wishlist now!

Construction Simulator has always been about powerful machines, heavy-duty contracts, and the satisfaction of watching a construction site come together piece by piece. 

For the first time in the series, you will be able to step out of the machine and take part in construction work directly. From using hand tools to completing small-scale jobs on site, manual labor adds a new layer of interaction, immersion, and variety to your day-to-day work.

So grab your tools, put on your workwear, and get ready to take construction into your own hands.

GET TO WORK.

text:
MXGP 26: The Official Game - Warm Up Trailer | PS5 Games
MXGP 26 - The Official Game releases October 2026! Thanks to the transition to Unreal Engine 5, MXGP 26 achieves a historic visual milestone. Expeerience fully rewritten motorcycle physics, and completely reworked rider animations and the terrain in MXGP 26 is now alive. Dynamic deformation technology alters the track as riders pass through.

Official 2026 season content in the spotlight! Here are the details below!
· Iconic Tracks: Including Bariloche in Argentina (volcanic soil), Riola Sardo in Sardinia (sand), Pietramurata in Italy (compact dirt), and Loket in the Czech Republic (hard-pack dirt).
· Elite Riders: Across both MXGP and MX2 categories, players will find stars of the sport such as Romain Febvre, Maxime Renaux, Kay de Wolf, and Calvin Vlaanderen.
· Full Customization: A comprehensive editor allows players to design their rider and customize official machines from championship manufacturers (Kawasaki, Husqvarna, Yamaha, KTM, Honda…) with gear from leading brands (Fox Racing, Alpinestars, Scott, Airoh, etc.)
